audience: marketers who shorten and track links with Cuttly

useCases.title: Check clicks, countries and referrers of a short link
useCases.text: Reads the click statistics of one short link: total clicks, clicks by source, top referrers, countries, device types and browsers.

useCases.title: Shorten a long URL
useCases.text: Creates a short link for a long URL, with an optional custom alias, and returns the short link and the page title.

useCases.title: Change a short link's alias, destination, title or tag
useCases.text: Changes the alias, destination URL, title or tag of a short link. A new alias makes the old short link stop working.

useCases.title: Set or remove a short link's expiration
useCases.text: Sets a link to expire after a number of clicks or on a date, optionally redirecting to another URL, or removes an expiration.

useCases.title: Send Android, iOS or Windows Mobile visitors elsewhere
useCases.text: Sets another destination, such as an app store page or a deep link, for visitors on one device type, and one for all other devices.

useCases.title: Delete a short link
useCases.text: Permanently deletes a short link and its statistics. The link stops working and cannot be restored.
